answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 90 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an inlet bet on surviving 90 epochs of grading, and every hollow settlement recomputes the ridge schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 38 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
